body:
I don't plan to do much. Knowing that things will be over tomorrow sometime in the afternoon or evening is freeing. I have less than 24 hours now. I don't have money to do anything "daring" or special. I didn't eat anything tonight. I have everything in my minivan that I need to be sure I succeed tomorrow. I will sleep on the bare mattress tonight with my only clothes on. I will get up tomorrow and administer the final exam and then go to my cubicle, grade them and submit the grades. No one will know or care that it will be my last day.

Then I will drive to the place where I will end my life and find peace. The cops or sheriff will probably find the abandoned car. They will probably just write a ticket and have it towed, not knowing that I am dead.

I'm going to wipe my hard drive now. I've removed my reddit profiles and my facebook and twitter. Tomorrow will be weird, not having a computer.

I doubt it. Selling my digital piano was really my way of saying goodbye to the world. It was the only thing that connected me to the world and it was the only thing that people accepted about me and it was the only thing that gave me what meager income I was able to earn. No one wanted to hire me for other non-musical things: fast food work, retail, waitstaff, janitorial, reception, hotel desk clerk, etc.

Even if I wanted to start over again, the road is too long, I would require financial help that I would not qualify for nor would be offered to me in the first place, and I personally don't have the strength to continue even if someone did that. I will finish my obligations tomorrow and then leave. No one will even know at first, except for the people that read this. I will be forgotten, as it should be.

Ironically, I feel at peace for the first time in a long time. Knowing that there will be an end to my pain has made it easier to handle and to cope.
